proposed_from.topic: K1 Fix a bivariate positive-coefficient linear SCM with independent second-order regularly varying innovations, arbitrary common bodies, local tail-index gap Delta_n, and intermediate sequence k_n; target the finite-threshold CTC contrast, not unrestricted causal direction. K2 derive the exact-Pareto and class-level forward and reverse population collision curves on the intrinsic threshold coordinate and its Delta_n log(n/k_n) corollary, including the sharp scaled-Pareto endpoints. K3 characterize the feasible relation between the logarithmic mixture and root-k_n ordering scales, and prove that a four-coordinate summed-marginal local experiment is invalid because it omits a root-k_n common-index coordinate and order-k_n joint exceedance-overlap intensity. K4 certify the constant full-alphabet direction set as an exactly honest label-equivariant fallback and state only the nontrivial experiment/ambiguity obstructions supported by the model. The augmented paired experiment, nonconstant envelope-conditional honest set, and matching opposite-orientation ambiguity frontier remain explicit open questions requiring additional joint-process, likelihood, bias, and contiguity primitives.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The scaled exact-Pareto theorem strictly refines fixed heterogeneous-tail endpoints into a nonconstant local curve. Unlike known-confounder-adjusted parametric CTC inference and stationary lagged/max CTC, the open kernel combines the logarithmic mixture coordinate with root-threshold ordering information and second-order bias on feasible static independent faces, then uses the marked experiment for an envelope-conditional structural direction set and a matched tail-rank ambiguity frontier.

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, Proposition 1, equation (A.23), Theorems 1--3, Introduction, and Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Derive the joint Le Cam experiment for the marked CTC tail process, tail-index scores, and second-order drift across the logarithmic and root-\(k_n\) collision scales.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed-gap dominant-tail limit in equation (A.23) by a two-component conditional exceedance mixture before applying the rank functional.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the exact CTC local-alternative, collision, adaptive-threshold, and minimax pairs returned only the 2026 anchor, fixed-threshold software, and time-series extensions; no joint local experiment was located.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate from Beirlant et al. (2006) LAN plus a delta method.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection fails because univariate LAN contains only \(\Delta_n\sqrt{k_n}\), whereas the CTC mark intensity varies with \(\Delta_n\log(n/k_n)\) and is coupled to second-order drift.

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, Proposition 1 and Section 5 finite-sample convergence discussion
seed_details.kernel: Give matching lower and upper envelopes for the probability that a CTC-tail direction report must remain ambiguous under local tail-index collisions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace marginal heavy-tail two-point alternatives by opposite-report marked structural tail arrays with controlled Hellinger distance.
seed_details.destination_search: Novak (2014) and Beirlant et al. (2006) cover marginal tail parameters; no opposite CTC-report contiguity theorem was found.
seed_details.cynical_objection: LiNGAM identifies the direction from the full non-Gaussian body, so opposite directions cannot be contiguous.
seed_details.rebuttal: The claim is explicitly for the CTC tail-rank experiment, not unrestricted full-body causal discovery; this restriction matches the estimator and applications under study.

seed_details.kernel: Compute the semiparametric efficiency bound for regular estimation of the finite-threshold CTC contrast in the collision experiment and construct an attaining one-step estimator.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Augment the univariate slowly-varying nuisance tangent space by the causal-mixture mark score and project the CTC derivative onto the joint tangent space.
seed_details.destination_search: The located efficiency results concern scalar tail indices, not rank-based causal mixtures.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The efficient influence function follows mechanically once the joint LAN experiment is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: The projection is nontrivial, but the seed is derivative of S1 and therefore is not retained as the independent headline.
seed_details.decision: dropped as a corollary lane of S1

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, Section 4 threshold discussion, Section 5 simulations, and Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Construct an adaptive threshold and an honest set-valued CTC direction report valid at equality, under either ordering, and under second-order bias.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the anchor's externally simulation-chosen \(k_n\) and pointwise normal approximation by simultaneous multiscale tail-process calibration.
seed_details.destination_search: Carpentier and Kim (2014) and Sasaki and Wang (2024) give scalar tail intervals; no bivariate CTC direction set after threshold selection was located.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Immediate by applying an honest interval separately to both tail indices and then pretesting their order.
seed_details.rebuttal: Separate intervals miss the logarithmic mixture coordinate and do not control the selected CTC rank process; the pretest is nonregular at equality.

seed_details.kernel: Characterize the actual finite-threshold target of empirical CTC under a local tail-index gap and subtract the leading second-order mixture bias.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain both terms in the propagated-to-idiosyncratic tail ratio instead of sending that ratio to zero or infinity.
seed_details.destination_search: No closed-form local CTC transition was located; the anchor reports slow convergence only through simulations.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is just the anchor's equation (A.23) without taking its limit.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact-Pareto curve survives, but a paper limited to this characterization would not deliver the joint inference problem; it is retained as Theorem 1 rather than the headline seed.
seed_details.decision: retained as the kill-test theorem inside S1

seed_details.anchor: CarpentierKim2014CI, Theorems 3.2 and 3.6, linked to the prior-proposal threshold-selection opportunity
seed_details.kernel: Determine the unavoidable adaptation penalty for choosing \(k_n\) when the local tail gap and second-order class are both unknown.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the scalar second-order testing modulus by a three-way modulus containing variance, second-order bias, and structural-mixture dilution.
seed_details.destination_search: Adaptive Hill-selection and scalar confidence-interval papers do not study a coupled bivariate CTC contrast.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The logarithmic penalty from scalar tail-index adaptation transfers unchanged.
seed_details.rebuttal: The scalar modulus has no \(\exp\{-\Delta_n\log(n/k_n)\}\) term, so neither its oracle threshold nor its testing distance transfers.
seed_details.decision: dropped in favor of the broader honest-set lane S4

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, permutation causality test following Theorem 2
seed_details.kernel: Invert a label-swap permutation test into a finite-sample direction confidence set at equal innovation tail indices.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Identify a group action under which the complete bivariate rank array is invariant at the equality boundary.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor and Pasche et al. use permutation calibration, but no exact equality-boundary group theorem is stated.
seed_details.cynical_objection: Equal tail indices do not make the two coordinates exchangeable when \(X_2=\beta X_1+\epsilon_2\).
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds: no valid exact symmetry remains under the structural edge and arbitrary body.

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, climate and finance decision applications
seed_details.kernel: Choose a tail-intervention policy using the estimated CTC direction and derive welfare regret under collision.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Define a policy-value functional that links a CTC rank contrast to intervention welfare.
seed_details.destination_search: No published mapping from CTC to treatment welfare was found.
seed_details.cynical_objection: CTC is a direction contrast, not a policy-value functional, so welfare regret is unidentified from the stated model.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without adding an economic loss model outside the brief.
seed_details.decision: dropped after red-team; documents the required M16 obstruction

seed_details.kernel: Prove asymptotic equivalence of direct empirical-rank CTC and integrated empirical-tail-copula estimators and derive the local-gap frontier where their feasible bootstrap approximations diverge.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Make the survival-copula representation uniform as its evaluation point approaches the boundary with a changing tail mixture.
seed_details.destination_search: Bücher and Dette (2013) cover tail-copula bootstrap, while the anchor gives an exact finite-sample representation but no local divergence frontier.
seed_details.cynical_objection: The two estimators are algebraically identical in the anchor's Lemma 1.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the point estimators; only bootstrap implementations differ, which is too procedural for the headline.

seed_details.anchor: LeimenstollSchienle2026, Conclusion on time dependence, and BodikPawlasPalus2023
seed_details.kernel: Derive the local-collision limit law for the time-series CTC under extremal clustering and heterogeneous innovation tails.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the i.i.d. tail empirical process by a cluster-functional process while retaining the two-component local mixture.
seed_details.destination_search: Bodik, Pawlas, and Palus (2023) explicitly note unresolved estimation behavior under different tail indices.
seed_details.cynical_objection: This is an ordinary i.i.d.-to-mixing extension.
seed_details.rebuttal: Extremal cluster marks interact nontrivially with the local mixture, but the destination changes the brief's fixed i.i.d. model and is less directly feasible than S1.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 2 / ass:declared-bias-envelope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The direction-set guarantee is conditional on a declared second-order-bias envelope B_n; B_n is not estimated from the data.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform honesty and the finite sensitivity family are claimed only conditional on the reported envelope B_n (or B_n^(c)), not as adaptation to an unknown envelope.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 3 / technical_internal_limitation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The converse restricts procedures to the CTC tail-rank sigma-field T_n.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The matched ambiguity frontier is a lower bound for T_n-measurable tail-rank procedures, not for unrestricted causal discovery from the full observed distribution.
